purpose: Track source provenance, license checks, and import status for locally hosted Chaos Cartridge games.
policy: Only mark a game imported when upstream source is actually present locally and required license/attribution notices are bundled. A source link or original prototype is not an import.

imports.notes: Existing local import; retain upstream license and attribution.

imports.title: Asteroids
imports.notes: Existing local adaptation; verify exact upstream provenance against its bundled notice.

imports.title: Custom Tetris
imports.notes: Single-file upstream implementation with Knightfall styling, account save/resume, and score submission.

imports.title: Snek Souls
imports.notes: Single-file upstream Snake game with Knightfall account save/resume controls and leaderboard submission.

imports.title: Hextris
imports.notes: Bundled source and vendor dependencies; removed upstream remote analytics, advertising, and external score beacon; added account score and save/resume integration.

notYetImported.blocker: Next.js/TypeScript project; needs build/dependency audit and static export compatibility review.

notYetImported.license: Code and artwork have different terms
notYetImported.blocker: Artwork is CC-BY-NC; do not redistribute those assets in this project. A code-only import needs a clean asset replacement and attribution audit.
